method.method_draft: Read the image as a 3 by 3 table with corner entries 1, 0, 4, 3 and center entry 2; the four unknowns are the non-corner edge cells. From the text, there are four 2 by 2 sub-tables, each summing to 10, so the combined total over all four 2 by 2 sub-tables is 40. Count how often each cell is included in these four sub-tables: each corner is counted once, the center is counted four times, and each edge-middle blank is counted twice. The known contribution is 1+0+4+3+4·2=16. Therefore twice the sum of the four blanks is 40-16=24, so the sum of the blanks is 12.

Thus 16 + 2S = 40, so 2S = 24 and S = 12.
